jobs.title: Senior Associate Project Manager - Creative Ops
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The VMS Co-Op is a group of fast-growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. This position's home company is a leader in the VMS sector, known for its vibrant brands.

The Senior Associate Project Manager plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of creative initiatives across Campaigns, Brand, Packaging, and Innovation. Working closely with Creative, Marketing, Brand Strategy, Commercial, Product Development, Regulatory, and Operations teams, this role helps ensure projects move efficiently from intake through delivery.

This position serves as a key operational partner to the Creative team, managing day-to-day project coordination, timelines, communications, and processes that keep work moving forward. By driving operational excellence across a portfolio of projects, the Senior Associate Project Manager enables creative teams to focus on delivering impactful work while building the skills and experience necessary to grow into larger project leadership responsibilities.

This role reports to the Sr. Manager of Creative Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Support the management of creative projects from intake through final delivery across Campaigns, Packaging, and Brand initiatives.
Build and maintain project timelines, workbacks, trackers, and project documentation.
Coordinate project kickoffs, status meetings, reviews, approvals, and stakeholder communications.
Track project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
Ensure project information, timelines, assets, and deliverables are accurate, organized, and up to date.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, align expectations, and support project execution.
Assist with intake management, project routing, and workflow coordination across the Creative team.
Support resource tracking and workload planning to help balance team capacity and project needs.
Maintain project management systems and reporting tools that provide visibility into active work streams.
Help identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and team efficiency.
Partner with Sr. Project Managers and Creative Operations leaders to support portfolio management and operational excellence.
Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that helps teams do their best work.

The Candidate

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented project manager with a passion for creative excellence. They enjoy being at the center of the action, helping teams stay organized, informed, and focused on what matters most. They are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a passion for making complex projects feel manageable.

They thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy collaborating across teams, and know how to keep multiple work streams moving simultaneously. They are comfortable balancing competing priorities, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and finding solutions when challenges arise.

Most importantly, they are someone who takes ownership, follows through, and genuinely enjoys helping teams work more effectively together.

Capabilities + Skills Required

2-5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or related fields.
Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, creative development, or brand initiatives.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Experience building and maintaining timelines, trackers, project plans, and documentation.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple moving pieces with accuracy.
Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
Experience working with project management tools and systems.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to build relationships across functions.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong follow-through and accountability.
Desire to grow into larger project leadership and operational management responsibilities.

Interview Process

Initial video screen with a member of the Talent team.
Round 1: Conversation with the Hiring Manager + 1-2 conversations with other team members.
Round 2: 2-3 conversations with team or cross-functional members.
Final Round: Homework. Candidates who participate in this round are given questions in advance to answer and present to the interview panel. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to adjust this procedure, please let us know as soon as possible.

The Details

LOCATION: Remote, USA - 4X travel per year to company offsites. HOURS: Full time, exempt (salary). MANAGER: Sr. Manager of Creative Operations. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

What We Offer

An opportunity to work with an intelligent, inspiring, and extraordinarily fun team.
100% of premiums paid for employee-only medical, dental + orthodontics, and vision insurance.
4 weeks PTO + paid holidays + 12 Mental Health Days per year.
100% Paid parental leave, Fertility + Adoption Benefits.
Annual Bonus.
401(k) plan with Employer Match.
Hybrid Work + Wellness + Cell Phone Stipends.
Free product.
And much more.

The hiring company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

jobs.description:
Wir sind stolz auf unsere Leistung! Mittlerweile sind es 100 Jahre, in denen wir als Top-Hersteller von Tondachziegeln, Betondachsteinen und zukunftsweisenden Energiedächern im Zentrum Europas unsere Kunden beraten und beliefern. Als unabhängiges Unternehmen mit fünf Produktionsstandorten in Deutschland stehen wir für Begeisterung, Ehrlichkeit, Urteilsvermögen - und dafür, Dinge gemeinsam voranzubringen. Wenn Du genauso tickst, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

Wir befinden uns in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und Transformation unseres Unternehmens. Zahlreiche strategische und operative Projekte treiben diese Entwicklung voran. jobs.title: Program Manager - Water by Design
jobs.description:
About us

Healthy Land & Water (HLW) works with community, industry, and government to deliver innovative and science-based solutions to challenges affecting our landscapes, waterways, and biodiversity. We help people understand the values and condition of South East Queensland’s environment so we can ensure the sustainable use of our natural environment long into the future. We believe that maintaining healthy landscapes and waterways is not just important for wildlife and ecosystems. A healthy environment also supports a vibrant economy, strong livelihoods, great lifestyles and the happiness and wellbeing of the community. Through our work, we encourage people to examine and change their behaviours for the benefit of the natural world and for the people and places we love.

The opportunity

The Program Manager supports the Environment & Sustainability Manager and leads the delivery of key programs in Water by Design under erosion sediment control, storm water engineering, capacity building, and the sustainable development space. The role provides day-to-day program management including project accountability, technical leadership, stakeholder engagement, and team leadership including coaching, and mentoring team members to ensure delivery of high-quality outcomes for clients, funding partners, and the broader community. This is a full-time max-term contract role for 9 months until the end of June 2027, however part-time arrangements may be considered for the right candidate.
Your responsibilities will include:

Leading the planning, coordination, and delivery of assigned programs and projects to achieve strategic, contractual, and operational objectives.
Developing and overseeing program plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, and reporting frameworks to ensure successful delivery of outcomes.
Coordinating multi-disciplinary teams and resources to deliver agreed work packages in accordance with client requirements, contractual obligations, and organisational priorities.
Monitoring program performance, risks, issues, and dependencies, implementing appropriate mitigation and corrective actions where required.
Developing and maintaining strong relationships with local government, developers, consultants, industry bodies and other key stakeholders to support successful program outcomes and program growth.
Translating stakeholder needs into targeted projects, events, training, resources and services.
Ensuring stakeholders receive timely communication regarding program progress, outcomes, and emerging issues.
Providing professional leadership and subject matter expertise to support high-quality program outcomes and continuous improvement.
Applying specialist scientific, environmental, engineering, or program management expertise to guide project delivery and solve complex operational challenges.
Preparing and reviewing high-quality reports, proposals, tenders, presentations, and technical documentation.

About you

Ideally, you will share our vision to lead the change that will deliver an environment for future generations to thrive. To be successful in this role, you will have all or many of the following requirements:
Tertiary qualifications in Science, Engineering, Environment, Business, or relevant field
Demonstrated experience managing complex programs or projects from planning through to delivery, preferably over multi-years
Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, industry, research organisations, and community groups
Excellent understanding of project management processes, strategies, and methods
Experience in natural resource management, sustainability, science, infrastructure, environment, or related sector
Ability to motivate and influence team members to ensure all deliverables are met and performed to a high standard
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Strong business and financial acumen with an ability to understand wider business operations

What we offer

We’re a diverse team of experts, who enjoy sharing knowledge and learning. We recognise and celebrate our employees and teams for affecting real and innovative change in our communities. We value integrity, collaboration, care, innovation, and courage. Some of our benefits include:
Flexible working arrangements
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support your mental, nutritional, and financial wellbeing
Novated leasing
Annual individual professional development budget
Annual life & wellbeing reimbursement
Paid Birthday leave
Monthly staff social activities and events
3 days paid Gifted leave over the holiday period
Purchased leave
Cashbacks and discounts via online store

jobs.description:
Position Summary

EOTECH is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Program Manager to lead and oversee product development initiatives spanning both external (customer) and internal (R&D/NPD) programs. This critical role will manage all aspects of assigned programs and customer relationships, including planning and execution, proposals, on time delivery, budget, product compliance, SOW management and New Product Launch phase gate process adherence, bringing digital night vision camera technologies and products to defense and commercial markets. This position requires a strategic thinker with exceptional leadership, organizational and communication skills to drive innovation and ensure successful product launches.

This individual contributor position reports to the Director, New Product Development.

To learn more about EOTECH Edge Vision Systems, please visit EOTECH Edge Vision Systems.

Essential Functions

Customer Engagement:

Serve as the primary point of contact for external and internal customers, fostering strong relationships and ensuring their needs are integrated into product development activities.
Gather and analyze customer feedback to guide program priorities, and product design and functionality.
Regularly communicate program updates, technical solutions, and progress reports to customers and key internal stakeholders.
Secondary Objective, on non-interference basis, to routinely assess a broader scope of the customer’s organizational hierarchy for decision making and alternate vehicle platforms or programs for new business opportunities.
Generate periodic, sometimes government TINA compliant, proposals in response to customer RFPs to address program requirements, overruns, or changes in scope.

Program Leadership

Manage end-to-end technology and product development programs, from concept to commercialization, ensuring alignment with company goals and market demands.
Coordinate and lead execution of cross-functional teams, including R&D, engineering, operations, quality, supply chain, and finance.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, budgets and risk mitigation strategies.

New Product Development (NPD)

Lead the NPD process, ensuring adherence to stage-gate methodologies and quality standards.
Define product specifications, performance metrics, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.
Oversee product launches, ensuring seamless transitions from development to production.

Stakeholder Management

Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
Resolve conflicts, address challenges, and maintain a collaborative environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is an on-site position in Santa Clara, CA. Remote work is not possible for this role.
Our office has a 9/80 work schedule, Monday through Friday.
Must be willing to travel both domestically and internationally, up to 20% of the time.
Overtime work may be required, as assigned. Extended working hours may be necessary to achieve business objectives.
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to perform all essential functions effectively, in addition to other demands.
Extended periods of working at a computer at a desk, as needed.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years of experience in program management, product development, or R&D, with a focus on NPD.
Proven track record of managing complex, customer-facing projects in a fast-paced environment.
Strong technical background and understanding of product development processes.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira) and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, Project, Outlook, Excel).
Track record of developing and implementing NPD/NPI process for complex technical products.
Experience in writing GOV Pricing and Proposals, including TINA and other regulatory compliance.
Knowledge of budgeting, cost estimating, and fiscal management principles and procedures.
Proven leadership skills, including communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering value.
Able to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing requirements.
Team-building skills to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
jobs.description:
Description

The World Wide Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.

We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA capacity and inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory, and capacity. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.

Key job responsibilities

Partner with in-country FBA, Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
Build and maintain root-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in Country Business reviews (weekly/monthly/quarterly) forums and ensuring that system-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
Design and run structured experiments with sellers - adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build evidence-based initiatives.
Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday (BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
MBA or Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field
8+ years experience in program management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end-to-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross-functional teams to drive improvement
Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in inventory and capacity planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor-facing operations at scale
Experience working in or closely with non-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

Speak, write, and read fluently in English

jobs.description:
The SMS Architect Program Manager builds, implements, and maintains the Safety Management System across mobility operations supporting a large driver workforce. Reporting to the Director of Mobility Safety, this role designs the SMS framework, leads safety risk and change management processes, and establishes standardized hazard identification, risk assessment, safety assurance, and continuous improvement practices. The position partners across Operations, Incident Management, EHS, HR, Training, and Legal to embed a proactive, data-driven safety culture aligned with FAA SMS, ICAO Annex 19, ISO 45001, and applicable partner requirements.

A Day in the Life:
No two days are the same. You may begin by reviewing hazard reports and emerging trends, then facilitate a risk assessment, evaluate the effectiveness of an existing control, or coordinate a change management review. Throughout the day, you will partner with cross-functional leaders, track mitigation and corrective actions, refine safety metrics and dashboards, support SMS technology implementation, and translate complex safety requirements into practical processes and training. Your analytical approach, sound judgment, and ability to influence stakeholders will help strengthen accountability and advance a proactive safety culture.

What You’ll Do:
Design, implement, and maintain an SMS framework aligned with FAA SMS, ICAO Annex 19, ISO 45001, applicable partner requirements, and industry best practices
Configure and administer the hazard reporting system; analyze submissions, identify trends, track actions, and close the loop with reporters
Lead safety risk management activities, including risk assessments, change management reviews, mitigation prioritization, residual risk evaluation, and risk acceptance
Perform safety assurance assessments to evaluate SMS effectiveness, validate controls, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions to closure
Define leading and lagging safety indicators, develop dashboards, report results to leadership, and assess safety-culture maturity
Create and deliver practical SMS training for employees and leaders on hazard reporting, risk assessment, risk acceptance, and SMS responsibilities
Partner with Operations, Incident Management, EHS, HR, Training, and Legal to integrate SMS requirements into business processes and operational decisions
Maintain the Safety Policy, SMS Manual, risk registers, procedures, and related process documentation
Serve as project manager for onboarding and implementing SMS software and tools supporting enterprise-wide adoption
Benchmark SMS practices, identify maturity gaps, and recommend improvements that strengthen safety performance and organizational learning

What We’re Looking For:
Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Engineering, Aviation, or a related field required
Five or more years of experience in safety management, SMS implementation, or risk management, preferably within transportation, aviation, logistics, or another high-reliability industry
Strong knowledge of recognized SMS frameworks, including FAA SMS, ICAO Annex 19, ISO 45001, or equivalent standards
Experience with hazard reporting systems and risk assessment methodologies such as bow-tie analysis, FMEA, and risk matrices
Strong facilitation and training skills, with the ability to design and deliver content for diverse audiences
Analytical, data-driven approach and proficiency with safety metrics, trend analysis, and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex safety concepts for nontechnical stakeholders
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, meet deadlines, and drive accountability
IOSA Auditor certification or a comparable credential, such as SMS Auditor, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, or Aviation Safety Auditor, is preferred
Experience in mobility, rideshare, autonomous vehicles, fleet operations, or another rapidly evolving operational environment is preferred
Familiarity with Samsara or a similar telematics or safety platform is preferred
Experience leading organizational culture change or process transformation is preferred

Program Summary

KBR’s Exploration & Logistics (E&L) business unit delivers mission-critical solutions supporting global defense, federal civilian, logistics, engineering, and space exploration missions. The business unit supports customers across the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and commercial partners, delivering innovative solutions that enhance mission readiness, operational effectiveness, and long-term mission success.

Job Summary

The Program Manager (PM) serves as the single point of accountability and primary interface between KBR and the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) for all contract performance under the Public Assistance Technical Assistance Contract (PA TAC VI). The PM provides executive leadership, strategic direction, operational oversight, and quality management to ensure the successful delivery of technical, programmatic, and administrative support services in support of FEMA's Public Assistance Program and disaster recovery mission.

The PM is responsible for planning, organizing, directing, coordinating, and controlling all contract activities, resources, personnel, subcontractors, and deliverables while ensuring compliance with contract requirements, FEMA policies, federal regulations, and applicable performance standards. The PM leads a geographically dispersed workforce capable of supporting multiple concurrent disasters nationwide and ensures rapid mobilization, scalable operations, and continuous mission readiness. This position requires the ability to support nationwide disaster operations, including periodic travel and availability during emergency activation periods. In addition, Direct day-to-day contract execution across all task orders and disaster assignments and managing nationwide surge operations and disaster deployment activities which includes: coordinating staffing, resource allocation, and workload balancing to support multiple simultaneous disaster operations. While ensuring timely mobilization, deployment, tracking, and demobilization of personnel, the PM must have sound PM skills and capabilities demonstrated by supporting other FEMA programs or similar complex programs.

The PM will ensure contract performance meets or exceeds all performance metrics, service level requirements, and quality standards and leads program governance activities, including executive reviews, performance assessments, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives. jobs.title: Business analyst
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high-speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO and CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $100,000/yr - $120,000/yr

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Analyze security alerts and investigate cybersecurity incidents to determine root causes and appropriate remediation actions.
Support incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts with technical and business stakeholders.
Review and analyze security logs from various sources, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection platforms, cloud environments, identity providers, AI platforms, and other security technologies.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Maintain, optimize, and enhance security tools and technologies to ensure optimal performance and effectiveness.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related Associate's or Bachelor's degree.
Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, application security, cloud security, software development, or a related technical role.
Experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, risk assessment, and security control implementation.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.
Strong hands-on information security skills and experience.
Ability to work independently on projects as assigned.
Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Proficient In The Following Areas

About This Role

About Product Strategy

We are growing the Product Strategy Platform in Budapest for our Multi-Asset Strategies & Solutions franchise that plays a central role in offering clients and prospects connectivity to and information on the investment process ensuring a best in class client experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of activities, including but not limited to maintaining fund data and analytics as well as production of marketing collateral and client reports. We seek an Analyst to join the MASS team.

Introduction to Multi Asset Strategies & Solutions Group

BlackRock's Multi-Asset Strategies & Solutions (MASS) team is the investment group at the heart of BlackRock's portfolio construction, asset allocation, and active management ecosystem. MASS draws on the full toolkit of BlackRock's index, factor, and alpha-seeking investment capabilities to deliver precise investment outcomes and cutting-edge alpha insights. MASS constructs active asset allocation strategies and whole portfolio solutions across a wide spectrum of commingled funds, separate accounts, model portfolios, and outsourcing solutions in the wealth and institutional channels. Our team of over 625 multi-asset investment professionals manages over $1 trillion in assets and operates across 31 offices in 18 countries worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Closely follow global markets and be up to date on events and movements
Perform analyses to help position funds/strategies
Prepare and maintain product pitchbooks, portfolio review decks and other marketing collateral, ensuring these meet compliance practices
Assist Portfolio Managers and senior Product Strategists with complex ad-hoc requests
Update DDQs and RFPs with product and strategy level information
Support and investigate technology and process options to scale and automate routine client service activities using Python/BlackRock technology
Keep abreast of regulatory and other structural trends and ensure that both new and existing products comply with regulatory requirements
Be part of a truly global team and work with colleagues in New York and London daily
Liaise with other team members across Budapest Product Strategy and help establish a culture of excellence within the group
Give short presentations at internal meetings, events

Curious: You like to learn new things and have a healthy disrespect for status quo
Brave: You are happiest outside your comfort zone
Passionate: You feel personal ownership for the work you do and an aspiration to be better
Open: You value and respect input from others
Experimental: You make mistakes, but learn from them
Geeky: You want to outsmart the problem

BA/BS required with degrees in quantitative, finance or economics disciplines preferred
Desire to learn more about the Investment Management industry
Fluency in written and spoken English is essential; additional European languages are a plus
Strong attention to detail, a sense of urgency around deadlines and an ability to multitask
High proficiency in Excel, with ability to manipulate data in a spreadsheet (knowledge of macros is a plus) and PowerPoint, with ability to create appealing slides for clients/investors
Strong data management and manipulation skills; Experience with Python or other coding languages
Proactive, problem-solving attitude supported by the ability to effectively combine outputs from different sources of technology/systems
Keen interest in global financial markets; be up to date on macro events and market trends
A desire to pursue CFA, FRM and/or CAIA is welcome

The salary range for Hungary is 9785000 - 13400000 HUF

Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior / Lead Data Analyst based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to shape data-driven strategy for subscription products within a collaborative Decision Science environment. You will analyze customer behavior across the full subscription lifecycle, from acquisition and engagement to retention and churn. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Finance, and Data teams, you will turn complex datasets into insights that influence product and business decisions. You will play a key role in defining KPIs, improving measurement frameworks, and identifying opportunities for growth and customer retention. The position combines advanced SQL, experimentation, statistical analysis, data visualization, and customer analytics. You will also help strengthen tracking, data quality, and analytics best practices across subscription products. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced analyst who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and translating data into meaningful business outcomes.

Accountabilities

Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Data teams to define and evolve KPIs and performance metrics across acquisition, engagement, retention, and churn.
Analyze subscription customer behavior to identify trends, patterns, growth opportunities, engagement drivers, and retention challenges.
Develop actionable insights that help inform product strategy, customer experience, and broader business decisions.
Design and support A/B tests and experimentation programs, including hypothesis development, experiment design, statistical analysis, and post-test evaluation.
Apply statistical methods and causal inference techniques to assess the impact of product and business initiatives.
Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to improve behavioral tracking, data models, data quality, and analytical reliability.
Build, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using BI platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Identify analytical and measurement gaps and implement improvements to the data and reporting processes supporting subscription products.
Establish and promote best practices for customer tracking, analytics, experimentation, KPI definition, and measurement.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Use customer and product data to proactively surface business opportunities and support evidence-based decision-making.
Contribute to a culture of data-driven product development through knowledge sharing, analytical standards, and cross-functional collaboration.

Requirements

5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Decision Scientist, or in a similar analytical role.
5+ years of hands-on experience working with complex, production-level SQL and independently developing high-quality queries.
Strong expertise in experimental design, A/B testing, statistical analysis, and causal inference.
3+ years of experience implementing custom tracking and establishing analytics best practices using a Customer Data Platform (CDP), such as Segment.
Professional experience with BI and data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience working with dbt and/or ETL environments and an understanding of data transformation workflows.

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst (Driver Squad)
jobs.description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a sharp, business-savvy Staff Data Analyst to drive business outcomes through impactful analytics within the Driver and Deliveries domain. The ideal candidate navigates uncertainty effortlessly and thrives in high ownership environments. They create business impact with the right tool for the job — turning complex analytics into actionable insights, leveraging AI to bring proof-of-concept products to life and influencing and collaborating with stakeholders across teams to reach your goal.

Team structure

We believe in opinionated analytics and creating an edge through intelligent use of technology and data in an industry that has been stuck in its ways for too long - for better or worse. That’s why we empower our growing team of engineers, data and product folks by embedding them in domain-centered, cross-functional squads for meaningful business context. We take initiative for impactful projects from day one. We hone our craft and grow our skills as analytics professionals through functional reporting lines and regular catch-ups and knowledge sharing sessions across the Data and wider “HIVEDmind” organisation (= Tech + Data + Product + AI&Automations).

Day-to-day activities

In your day-to-day you will drive measurable progress through innovative solutions to business problems and identify new opportunities using data analytics. You define the most meaningful KPIs and metrics and help capture them in data models and reports. Being embedded in the Driver Squad, you will work closely with your team mates across Tech and Product to deliver performance and efficiency insights and inform the squad’s roadmap. Equally, you will collaborate closely with Operations stakeholders beyond your squad to find efficiency gains and opportunities in our data and processes.

How You Create Impact

The Driver Squad’s mission is to create the industry’s leading delivery operation, identifying and incentivising the best delivery performance across both cost efficiency and delivery quality. You will develop thought leadership across Driver Pay, Driver Performance and Incentivisation and corresponding analytics, identifying opportunities for technological innovation or process improvements and bringing them to life. Your target metrics include delivery success rate, delivery quality, driver retention, unit cost or vehicle utilisation and you only ever consider your job done when your metric has measurably improved.

Line management

While this role is focussed mostly on individual contributions, you will also take line management responsibility for 1-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals within your team. This role reports directly into the VP Data.

Responsibilities 📋

Uncover business and product opportunities through robust analytics in a highly complex domain, translating technical insights with clarity for any audience.
Shape data-driven decision-making across your squad and the wider operation; develop actionable performance metrics that move the needle.
Size and measure the impact of ongoing initiatives and innovations.
Build powerful data models and products that deliver actionable insights to your teammates.
Line-manage 1-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals: empower them through clear feedback, meaningful coaching, and leading by example.
Raise the bar: role-model analytical rigour and smart pragmatism to shape analytics excellence across the company.

Your profile 👤

5+ years of experience in a similar analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence or data science role.
Experience line managing or mentoring other data professionals.
A passion for clean, efficient and meaningful SQL queries and Python notebooks.
Previous experience using modern BI tools (we use Looker + LookML).
AI-savvy to scale yourself and your impact.
Deeply outcome-focussed with a high sense of ownership.
An analytical mind and the necessary pragmatism to balance rigour with speed.
A high-energy and bold communicator who enjoys collaborating across teams from different functions.

Technologies we use 💻

Analytics: Looker, Data Studio, Python notebooks and geospatial analytics tools
Programming languages: Python, SQL
Data transformation and data quality: dbt, pandas/ polars, data-diff, Elementary
Core data platform: Dagster, dlt and Airbyte, BigQuery, Lakehouse for Iceberg (read about our platform here)
Infrastructure: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform

Our interviewing process 🪜

Intro call
SQL live coding task (real, anonymised data in a SQL editor)
Analytics take-home task and review
On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)

Our Values

😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.
🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.
💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.
🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How We Reward Our Team 🎁

Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team
Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role
25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays
1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off
Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy
Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans
Competitive salary + EMI options scheme
Annual compensation review
Team lunch provided once a week
Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)
Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right
Community volunteer days
Cycle to work scheme
Dog friendly office and depots
MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

🔍 Want to learn more?

🎥 Meet the team in 60 seconds: Behind the scenes with HIVED
HIVED is B Corporation certified
HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100
Read how HIVED raised $42M to transform parcel delivery with AI and all-electric logistics network
Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

About DHL and Corporate Real Estate:

DHL Group is the logistics provider of the world with over 580,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives. We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development, we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.

Corporate Real Estate
( CRE)
at DHL Group manages a global portfolio of more than 12,000 properties, covering over 30 million m² worldwide. With around 1,700 real estate professionals globally, we ensure that all DHL facilities are developed, operated, and maintained efficiently and sustainably across their entire lifecycle.

Join us and become part of a global CRE community shaping the logistics infrastructure of tomorrow.

Job purpose:

As a CRE Sustainability Project Manager
, you will play a key role in helping DHL Group achieve its sustainability and decarbonization ambitions across one of the world's largest real estate portfolios.

As part of the Group’s Sustainability Road Map (published 2021),
there are explicit sustainability commitments relating to real estate. Corporate Real Estate has a responsibility to provide a Building Decarbonization Framework (formerly CNB) that enables delivery of commitments. The Sustainable Buildings Project Manager, part of the global sustainability team, will project manage defined components of the Building Decarbonization Framework, conduct technology assessments and support implementation of technologies to reduce carbon emissions and improve energy efficiency – with a focus on PV and heating decarbonization.

Your tasks:

Building Decarbonization Framework & Heating Decarbonization

Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of DHL's global Building Decarbonization Framework ensuring alignment with DHL Group and divisional requirements. The framework defines an internal global standard for decarbonization & energy efficiency that is adopted by all divisions
Conduct market research and analysis of constantly evolving policies and legislation to ensure framework is relevant and compliant
Assess new technologies and solutions that can improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions across DHL facilities worldwide.
Drive process improvements to enable quicker and more accurate evaluation of technologies for greater deployment across the Group
Engage and upskill regional and country teams on the Building Decarbonization Framework, providing technical guidance and support in issue resolution
Maintain user guides and documents published and available to all Divisions, including supporting and contributing to training sessions

Solar PV and Heating Decarbonization assessments

Conduct technical and financial desktop assessments of solar PV and heating decarbonization opportunities across DHL properties.
Work with divisional colleagues to create assigned business cases for solar and low carbon heating infrastructure BCA approvals, including submissions at a Corp Board level. Typically, 20-30 business cases are completed a year
Support the implementation of solar PV and heating decarbonization projects, including updating the online tracker, overseeing progress and coordinating issue resolution

Desktop CNB Assessment for Business case approvals

Act as the primary contact and coordinate the desktop CNB assessments needed as part of Business Case Approvals (BCAs). This includes both assigning new assessments to team members, tracking progress, ensuring they are completed to required quality standard and coordinating issue resolution
Completing, with minimal supervision, a certain number of assigned desktop CNB assessments
Identification of process improvements and upskilling country colleagues

Your profile:

Degree in Sustainability, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Management, Construction, Finance or a related field.
3+ years of professional experience in sustainability, strategy development, renewable energy, building engineering, real estate sustainability, or a related area.
Strong interest in building decarbonization, solar PV, energy efficiency, and low-carbon technologies.
Experience managing projects and working with multiple stakeholders in an international environment.
Good understanding of sustainability principles, energy management, and climate-related challenges.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and business data.
Confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a global and virtual environment.
Passion for sustainability and driving meaningful environmental impact.

We offer:

Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world.
International and virtual environment.
Flexibility and great opportunity to learn.
Tempting compensation and benefits.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technically skilled Technical Project Manager to join the Estates and Facilities team at Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering a diverse programme of new-build, refurbishment, backlog maintenance and community capital projects across Frimley Health and community sites. The programme includes schemes ranging from approximately £50,000 to £30 million, with an anticipated capital investment of around £50 million per year over the next three years.

Main duties of the job

Working closely with the Associate Director of Hard FM and wider Estates and Facilities teams, you will take delegated responsibility for the successful delivery of capital schemes from feasibility and design through to construction, completion and handover. Your work will directly support the Trust's clinical and operational priorities, while helping to maintain and improve the estate.

You will bring specialist technical expertise in one or more of the following disciplines: building, technical, mechanical or engineering
, alongside strong project management experience within a complex environment.

This is a key role for a proactive professional who can confidently manage multiple projects, budgets, consultants and contractors, while ensuring schemes are delivered safely, effectively, on time and in line with Trust governance and statutory requirements.

If you are looking for an opportunity to make a tangible difference to healthcare environments and contribute to a significant programme of investment across Frimley Health, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Working for our organisation

Visa Sponsorship

This position is not eligible
for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK
for the full duration of the contract.

Why Join Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust?

At Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

As a Disability Confident Employer and recipient of the Gold Award in the Armed Forces Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively champion equality, diversity and inclusion, creating opportunities for people from all backgrounds to build rewarding careers within the NHS.

We also recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance. By supporting flexible working arrangements wherever possible, we enable our colleagues to balance their professional and personal commitments while continuing to deliver outstanding care to our patients. Whether flexibility means adjusted hours, part-time working, hybrid arrangements or alternative working patterns, we work in partnership with our staff to meet both individual and service needs.

Join Us

Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for your next challenge, Frimley Health offers the opportunity to be part of a inclusive, forward-thinking organisation that is committed to excellence, innovation and compassionate care. Together, we can shape the future of healthcare and make a real difference to the lives of the communities we serve.

Frimley Health Trust benefits on Vimeo

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

As a Capital Project Manager, you will:

Lead the feasibility, design and construction of allocated capital projects across the Trust estate and wider health facilities within the Integrated Care System (ICS).
Manage projects from inception through to completion, ensuring they meet agreed objectives, timescales, quality standards and financial parameters.
Provide specialist technical advice and guidance within your area of expertise, including building, technical, mechanical or engineering disciplines.
Support the Associate Director of Hard FM and Associate Director of Capital in the planning and delivery of the Trust's capital programme.
Manage project budgets and provide effective financial oversight, identifying and addressing risks, variances and potential pressures.
Work collaboratively with Trust Procurement colleagues to ensure projects are procured and delivered in accordance with Standing Orders, Standing Financial Instructions (SFIs) and relevant Trust procedures.
Coordinate and manage external consultants, professional advisers and contractors, ensuring clear project briefs, contractual arrangements, performance expectations and deliverables are established.
Provide regular progress reports and updates on allocated schemes, including financial, programme, quality and risk information.
Contribute to the development of business cases and the planning of future capital investment.
Ensure appropriate project documentation, records and electronic project files are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
Work closely with the CAD Manager to ensure Trust drawings are accurate and up to date, and that appropriate as-built and as-installed drawings are obtained for completed schemes.
Ensure all projects are delivered in accordance with relevant health and safety legislation, statutory requirements, approved codes of practice and Trust policies.
Build effective working relationships with clinical, operational and Estates and Facilities colleagues, as well as external consultants, contractors and other stakeholders.
Support delegated negotiations with specialist consultants, contractors and other external organisations on behalf of the Trust.
Contribute to the strategic development and planning of the Trust's estate, providing professional advice based on your technical expertise.

Please See Attached Job Description/Person Specification For Further Details.

Person specification

Qualifications

Essential criteria

Educated to degree level - Qualification in Architecture, Surveying or Engineering or Qualification in a design construction related discipline.
Good knowledge of current legislation and regulations in the construction industry.

Desirable criteria

Corporate membership of a construction related institute or body (e.g., RIBA, RICS, CIOB)
Working knowledge of Auto CAD system
Familiarity with NHS procedures, guides, and documentation.

Skills and Knowledge

Essential criteria

Excellent project management and change management skills.
Able to simultaneously manage a range of complex tasks and prioritise workload.
Strong negotiating skills.
Numerate and comfortable with budgetary management.
Able to deal effectively with other professional staff.
Able to write clear and concise reports and business cases.
IT Literate.
"Can do" attitude.
Able to communicate technical knowledge to a non-technical audience so this is easily understood.
Motivated and team player.
Demonstrates the ability to work on own initiative yet knows when to ask for help.
Able to problem solve and innovate - proactive systematic approach to work.

Desirable criteria

Knowledge of Capital Investment Manual.
Line management experience.

Professional / specialist / functional experience

Essential criteria

Significant experience of managing complex capital schemes.
Experience of writing specifications and tender documentation.
Experience of working with the ProCure 21+22 processes

Desirable criteria

Experience of working in an NHS or other healthcare environment.
Experience of public sector requirements.
Line management experience

Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust (FHFT) is proud of its strong reputation, record of achievement and ambition for the future. We serve a population of over 900,000 people across Berkshire, Hampshire, Surrey and South Buckinghamshire, and remain committed to improving the health and wellbeing of our communities.

Our new organisational strategy – FHFT 2030 – sets out our ambition to be the best place to receive care and the best place to work in the NHS. Underpinned by our Trust values – Committed to Excellence, Working Together, Facing the Future
, and being a modern, compassionate, Healthcare Organisation – we are creating a culture where our people can thrive and patients always come first.

We continue to invest heavily in our services and facilities. This includes the development of a new hospital at Frimley Park, major expansion of diagnostics and inpatient capacity, and the continued transformation of services across our sites. We have already delivered a brand-new £100m state-of-the-art Heatherwood Hospital, a £49m Emergency Assessment Centre at Wexham Park, and a £10m upgrade to maternity services.

We are also committed to sustainability and the NHS Net Zero ambition. Our new hospital and estate developments are being designed to be environmentally responsible, energy efficient, and future-proofed, featuring on-site renewables energy and intelligent energy systems. Through our green plan, we are embedding sustainable practices across all areas of care and operations, ensuring we reduce our environmental impact while improving population health and wellbeing. Our staff are key to helps us deliver on our ambition and to ensure sustainability is a core component of care delivery and our operations.

Alongside estates’ investments, we are embedding a strong focus on digital innovation and quality improvement. Our electronic patient record (Epic), launched in 2024, is already enabling safer, more connected, and more effective care for patients, while giving staff the tools they need to do their best work. Our electronic patient record also supports safe and effective digitised care pathways, savings time and carbon, whilst delivering excellent quality of care.

Everything we do is guided by our values, shaping how we care for patients, support colleagues, and build a sustainable future for healthcare together.

jobs.title: Business analyst
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare

The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology.
